content: MK calls Khwāndamīr's entry 'faint praise', contrasting it with his effusive entries on Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī (fellow historian, 'the noblest of the learned men of Iran') and on Kātibī (the most outstanding poet of Shāhrukh's time); MK suggests, with 'perhaps', that Khwāndamīr privileged poets, historians and Sufis and that Ṣāʾin al-Dīn fell into none of those categories.
